% Figure method: generated by figures/rse_fig_method.py; placed where the text first discusses it.
% Bin width, split into halves, shoreline and flood rules, offset fitting, count of exceeding
% levels and scale bars: Supplementary section rse_si_display.tex.
\begin{figure}[!tbp]
  \centering
  \includegraphics[width=\textwidth]{../figures/out/rse_fig_method.pdf}
  \caption{\textbf{The hindcast audit, step by step, on one example.}
  Example: Volga--Ural interfluve coast, GEBCO\_2026, level bin centred at \metric{erl.hero.e3_b029.level_m}~m (DAHITI reference).
  (a)~Left: daily basin level from altimetry (grey) and the \metric{erl.hero.e3_b029.n_acquisitions} Landsat acquisitions of \metric{erl.hero.e3_b029.first_year}--\metric{erl.hero.e3_b029.last_year} in the bin (shaded), in two interleaved halves (filled circles, A; open, B).
  Right: water frequency of each \metric{params.stage2_res_m}~m cell (blank, fewer than \metric{params.min_valid_obs} valid acquisitions); black, the observed shoreline.
  (b)~GEBCO\_2026 height minus the level, after the area-fitted offset $c$ (\metric{h1.shape_offset.gebco2026_m}~m); black, the predicted shoreline (edge of the flood from the open sea); hatched, below the level but not flooded.
  (c)~Left: predicted shoreline cells coloured by distance to the nearest observed shoreline cell; black, the observed shoreline; grey dashed and dotted, halves A and B.
  Right: cumulative distributions, over the sector at this level, of predicted-to-observed shoreline distances (blue) and of distances between the halves' shorelines (grey); the displacement $D$ is the median of the first, the observation noise floor $Q$ the \metric{params.err_pct_hi}th percentile of the second.
  (d)~$D/Q$ at the \metric{h1.n_evaluable.shape.gebco2026.interfluve} levels where both can be measured in this sector (filled, $D > Q$; open, $D \le Q$; ringed, the level of a--c); a grid fails the shoreline test where $D > Q$ at more than half of them.}
  \label{fig:rse_method}
\end{figure}
